summary: Banco Bradesco filed a 6-K attaching BlackRock's CVM Resolution 44/2021 material-equity-holding notice dated October 12, 2026, disclosing holdings as of October 8, 2026. BlackRock, as investment manager for clients, holds 562,349,871 preferred shares (511.7M shares plus 50.6M ADRs), ~10.060% of preferreds, 143,148,325 common shares (~2.553%), and 24,606,349 cash-settled derivatives on preferreds (~0.440%). BlackRock states the stake is strictly for investment, with no intent to alter control or management and no voting or trading agreements. Watch for 13G/13D-equivalent updates and any creep above thresholds.
